other_conditions: Must be a citizen of India
Must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra
Must be a student admitted/enrolled in a school recognized by the Govt. of Maharashtra
Must be a Person with Disability (Visually Handicapped, Low Vision, Hearing Impaired, Orthopedically Handicapped, etc.)
Disability percentage must be 40% or above
Must not have failed in the last qualifying examination
Must be pursuing a pre‑metric qualification (Class 1st to Class 10th)
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarship ranging from ₹100 to ₹300 depending on class and disability type.
